html:
ForgeMCP alpha for Unreal Engine 5.6

Target: UE 5.6.1, Win64 Development Editor. This is an actively developed alpha. The binary engine BuildId must match package-manifest.json. Other platforms, engine builds and packaged game targets require separate builds and acceptance.

Close the target editor before replacing a plugin. For engine-wide availability, place the MajesticForge folder inside <EngineRoot>/Engine/Plugins/Marketplace. Keep the folder and module names. Enable ForgeMCP in Edit > Plugins for the chosen project, restart it, then open Window > ForgeMCP. The alpha is disabled by default. Existing project-local copies can take precedence over the engine copy; back them up outside plugin search directories before migrating.

The engine-wide installer in the ForgeMCP source checkout validates the archive and exact engine BuildId and supports backed-up updates. Prefer it over manual copying. Preserve the previous installation outside plugin search directories for rollback. Save work and close editors before updating or restoring a backup.

The external ForgeMCP Python MCP server is installed separately. Configure it to launch the checkout's Python environment with -m server.main and set FORGE_UNREAL_SESSION_DIR to the target project's Saved/MajesticForge folder. Discover sessions and inspect the intended project's identity before edits. Never distribute session registration files; they contain credentials.

The source checkout's Documentation/UE56_Alpha.md records full setup, update, rollback, acceptance and feature limits. This package retains the existing license notice. Installation does not establish all-feature or visual acceptance.
